title: 第27章 售卖蓝卡
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
当二星器具卡都售卖之后，人群直接骚动了起来。

    “老板，除了佣兵大剑，还有没有其他高品质的卡牌啊？”

    众人见到了二星卡，自然对一星卡斥候短刃的期待感就降低了，心心念念都想要二星卡。

    “当然有！”

    林峰猛地一拍柜台，先前的随和褪去大半，双手抱胸时，肩膀微微舒展，一股傲气油然而生。

    他故意顿了顿，等众人的好奇心被吊到顶点，才朗声道：“我这儿还有最新出炉的三星蓝色品质器具卡，不过要等到下午才正式售卖！”

    “什么？蓝色品质？”

    人群前端有人惊呼出声，声音都变了调：“我没听错吧？他说的是蓝卡？”

    “千真万确，是蓝色品质！”林峰加重语气，目光扫过全场。

    人群里甚至传来了倒吸冷气的声音，一个穿着万卡阁制服的员工脸色骤变，喃喃道：“不可能……我们万卡阁在石铁城的分号连绿卡都经常断货，他一个小商铺，怎么会有蓝卡？林峰他……难道真的是制卡师？”

    见众人议论纷纷，显然不相信的模样，林峰拍了拍桌子示意他们安静。

    “大家请看，我手中的是什么？”

    众人循声望去，一张泛着深海蓝光的卡牌夹在林峰指缝，光芒温润却不刺眼，卡面上的幻影长剑在光晕中若隐若现，连剑穗的纹路都清晰可见。

    “嘶！”

    贪婪的吸气声连成一片，不少佣兵的喉结滚动，眼神炽热得像要把卡牌烧穿。有人悄悄握紧了腰间的武器，显然是有了不好的想法。

    “看来各位是忘了规矩。”

    林峰眉头一皱，四星御卡师的气势毫无保留地铺开。

    冰冷的杀意像寒风扫过人群，那些蠢蠢欲动的身影瞬间僵住，后背莫名渗出一层冷汗。

    一时间众人被这冰冷的杀意纷纷惊醒。

    他们突然想起来，林峰是身经百战的老佣兵了，在佣兵团都能担任副团长职务。

    “林、林峰大师！”

    先前那精瘦佣兵率先反应过来，语气瞬间恭敬了十倍。

    “您真要把这蓝色品质的卡牌拿出来售卖？”
content_en:
After all the two-star appliance cards were sold, the crowd immediately started to commotion.

    "Boss, besides Mercenary Great Sword, are there any other high-quality cards?"

    After everyone saw the two-star card, their expectations for the one-star scout dagger naturally dropped, and they all wanted the two-star card.

    "Of course!"

    Lin Feng slammed the counter, and most of his previous easygoingness faded away. When he crossed his arms, his shoulders relaxed slightly, and a sense of arrogance emerged spontaneously.

    He paused deliberately, waiting for everyone's curiosity to peak, and then said loudly: "I also have the latest Samsung blue quality appliance card here, but it won't be officially sold until the afternoon!"

    "What? Blue quality?"

    Someone at the front of the crowd exclaimed, and the tone of his voice changed: "Did I hear correctly? He said blue card?"

    "It's absolutely true, it's blue quality!" Lin Feng emphasized his tone and glanced across the audience.

    There was even a gasp of air from the crowd. An employee wearing Wanka Pavilion's uniform suddenly changed his face and murmured: "Impossible...our Wanka Pavilion branch in Shitiecheng often runs out of green cards. How can he have a blue card in a small shop? Lin Feng...is he really a card maker?"

    Seeing everyone talking and apparently not believing it, Lin Feng patted the table to signal them to be quiet.

    "Everyone, please look, what is in my hand?"

    Everyone looked around, and saw a card glowing with deep sea blue light sandwiched between Lin Feng's fingers. The light was gentle but not dazzling. The phantom sword on the card was looming in the halo, and even the lines on the sword's spikes were clearly visible.

    "Hiss!"

    There was a continuous sound of greedy breathing, and many mercenaries' Adam's apples rolled, and their eyes were so hot that they seemed to burn through the cards. Someone quietly tightened the weapon at his waist, obviously having bad thoughts.

    "It seems you have forgotten the rules."

    Lin Feng frowned, and the four-star card master's momentum spread out without reservation.

    The cold murderous intent swept through the crowd like a cold wind. Those figures who were ready to move froze instantly, and a layer of cold sweat broke out on their backs for no apparent reason.

    For a moment, everyone was awakened by the cold murderous intent.

    They suddenly remembered that Lin Feng was a veteran mercenary who had experienced many battles and could hold the position of deputy leader in the mercenary group.

    "Master Lin, Lin Feng!"

    The lean mercenary from before was the first to react, and his tone instantly became ten times more respectful.

    "Do you really want to sell this blue-quality card?"
